architecture.user_requirements: Build a scalable e-commerce platform with React frontend, .NET API backend, Azure SQL Database, Redis Cache, Azure Front Door, Key Vault, and Application Insights

services.name: Azure Front Door
services.description: Global load balancer and CDN with dynamic site acceleration

services.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
services.description: Container orchestration with horizontal pod autoscaling

services.name: Azure SQL Database
services.description: Relational database with read scale-out and columnstore indexes

services.name: Azure Cache for Redis
services.description: Distributed caching with clustering for improved performance

services.name: Azure Active Directory
services.description: Identity and access management with Conditional Access and Identity Protection

services.name: Azure Firewall
services.description: Centralized network security in hub-and-spoke topology

services.name: Application Gateway v2
services.description: Web application firewall and SSL termination with auto-scaling

critical_issues.issue: Public endpoints exposed without WAF protection

security_services.purpose: Zero Trust identity foundation with Conditional Access and Identity Protection
Centralized network security in hub-and-spoke topology
Web application firewall and SSL termination

quick_wins.improvement: Enable Azure CDN on blob storage

architecture_insights.design_rationale: The architecture leverages Azure Front Door for global load balancing and CDN, Application Gateway for WAF and SSL termination, and Azure Kubernetes Service for scalable backend hosting. Azure SQL Database and Azure Cache for Redis ensure high-performance data access. Security is enhanced with Azure Active Directory, Azure Key Vault, Azure Firewall, and Private Endpoints. Monitoring is provided by Azure Application Insights for end-to-end observability.
